phases.name: Price Fetcher / Spec Filler integration-ready foundation

requirements.title: Ice R7 acceptance
requirements.acceptance: 69 months lossless; latest Ice panels reconcile exactly; segment/body unknown remains visible; redirect cycle-free; wheel/tyre period_from respected.
requirements.evidence_required: Read-only production R7 report + workflow run + frozen package/master SHA.

requirements.title: Scoped decision and queue
requirements.acceptance: Every Ice group + registration-type pair is covered or visibly unresolved, including RY1/RY2/RY3/RY10; no silent ALL fallback.
requirements.evidence_required: V70 regression plus live class-specific queue readback, 3 known pickup fixtures.

requirements.title: Admin create/link/exclude resilience
requirements.acceptance: Authorized create, link, exclude are idempotent and recoverable; failed partial writes never masquerade as DONE.
requirements.evidence_required: DB transaction/compensation test, concurrent/retry tests and audit-log readback.

requirements.title: Powertrain estimate fidelity
requirements.acceptance: Use available Ice reg_est as estimate for range instead of midpoint; preserve min/max, certainty and source; no false exactness.
requirements.evidence_required: G63 2026-09 regression 5 not 7.5 + missing-estimate, aggregation, certainty and bounds tests.

requirements.title: Ice PR readiness
requirements.acceptance: Current Ice branch CI passes; roadmap and PR body reflect real production; owner explicitly authorizes merge; merge alone is not R8.
requirements.evidence_required: Immutable commit SHA, CI jobs, owner merge approval and reviewed work-state/roadmap diff.

requirements.title: Ice production cutover
requirements.acceptance: Production member market serves approved Ice release at its real period/master with no mixed legacy totals.
requirements.evidence_required: Production /member/market and API readback, latest period and total reconcile.

requirements.title: Entitlements
requirements.acceptance: Free/Pro quotas, scopes and authorization remain effective after cutover; no privileged data leak.
requirements.evidence_required: Free/Pro/admin negative and positive E2E tests, authenticated API logs.

requirements.title: Reversible cutover
requirements.acceptance: Owner-controlled flag off restores previous supported read path without data mutation; rollback rehearsed.
requirements.evidence_required: Flag-off/flag-on smoke reports, deployment SHA, rollback timings/observed output.

requirements.title: Consistent website freshness
requirements.acceptance: Any displayed registration total declares source/period; no August legacy and September Ice figures silently mixed.
requirements.evidence_required: Route inventory and screenshot/API fixture checks for /member and /member/market.

requirements.title: Authorized package upload
requirements.acceptance: One private-source upload accepts M7-sized or larger package; SHA matches independently owner-confirmed Ice delivery manifest; no write on failed check.
requirements.evidence_required: Upload/download exact-byte replay, wrong-hash, missing-signoff, oversize and access-control tests.

requirements.title: Atomic import and audit
requirements.acceptance: New package is staged, validated, committed once, read back against panel counts and totals; retries do not duplicate facts.
requirements.evidence_required: Same-package rerun + injection failures, import ledger, panel crosschecks.

requirements.title: Versioned crosswalk carry-forward
requirements.acceptance: Changing master 7.0 to another version preserves immutable historical owner decisions and produces a version-compatible serving snapshot without mismatched master errors.
requirements.evidence_required: Synthetic master upgrade 7.0→8.0 with unchanged identities and immutable provenance tests.

requirements.title: Identity delta handling
requirements.acceptance: Renames safely carry approved mapping; splits/merges/class changes create review or explicit evidence, never silent owner approval.
requirements.evidence_required: Fixture pack rename, split, merge, redirect cycle, stale target and registration-class collision.

requirements.title: One-upload one-owner-confirm workflow
requirements.acceptance: After one upload + explicit monthly owner approval, import→matcher/redirect→queue→acceptance runs without per-month code edits.
requirements.evidence_required: Realistic new-month end-to-end dry-run and manual go/no-go checkpoint.

requirements.title: Release activation and rollback
requirements.acceptance: Current member serving points only at accepted dataset+crosswalk pair; failed jobs cannot expose half-updated release.
requirements.evidence_required: Release pointer/feature-gate test, mid-pipeline failure replay, rollback evidence.

requirements.title: Unmapped/Excluded accounting
requirements.acceptance: Isuzu unidentified and other unknown units are preserved in total brand/missingness without guessing a model or pretending excluded means zero.
requirements.evidence_required: Historical/monthly accounting and raw-versus-covered report with samples.

requirements.title: RY and matcher replay
requirements.acceptance: RY class-specific decisions and Mercedes/Rolls matcher changes replay safely without overwriting owner locks.
requirements.evidence_required: Production-shaped shadow replay diff with no unauthorized approved-row mutation.

requirements.title: Ice panel access audit
requirements.acceptance: Registration province, powertrain, rim, tyre and metadata availability match package access/free-scope and period_from; not-yet-built UI is identified explicitly.
requirements.evidence_required: Panel-to-route matrix with API/permission/coverage and missingness checks.

requirements.title: Chinese EV ranking
requirements.acceptance: Clearly scoped and sourced BEV Chinese-brand ranking appears only when data + entitlement allow; otherwise explicit unavailable state.
requirements.evidence_required: Golden brand/origin/BEV/filter fixtures and Free/Pro UI smoke.

requirements.title: Website navigation cleanup
requirements.acceptance: Remove obsolete 4-of-6 selector when approved intelligence navigation is delivered without regressions.
requirements.evidence_required: Owner-approved design decision, route screenshots and navigation tests.

requirements.title: Catalog attributes completeness
requirements.acceptance: Segment/body status is enriched only from traceable evidence and governed edits; remaining unknown is truthfully counted.
requirements.evidence_required: Before/after missingness report, source refs and governed writer readback.

requirements.title: Legacy cleanup and operational docs
requirements.acceptance: Remove superseded one-time upload function only after dependency audit; record actual operational SOP and restore path.
requirements.evidence_required: Reference search, deployment report, access/readback and rollback checklist.

requirements.title: Canonical source/authority boundaries
requirements.acceptance: Ice registrations remain separate from Vehicle Master; only governed writer mutates canonical model, trim, price and spec facts.
requirements.evidence_required: Authorization tests and prohibited legacy/direct-write negative tests.

requirements.title: Price Fetcher adapter readiness
requirements.acceptance: Official OEM price/trim observation fixture traverses parse→evidence→identity reconcile→review→approved apply→serving.
requirements.evidence_required: Five-stage integration fixture, source/observed/effective metadata, missing/ambiguous/no-change tests.

requirements.title: Spec Filler adapter readiness
requirements.acceptance: Spec fixture maps brand/model/generation/variant/trim/field/unit/source to reviewable proposed changes without guessing or overwriting owner-locked values.
requirements.evidence_required: Fixture roundtrip and conflict tests, field-specific provenance/coverage, approved serve.

requirements.title: Safe structural changes
requirements.acceptance: Model/brand/trim identity changes have scoped validation, deterministic revisions, idempotent retries, fail-closed partial writes.
requirements.evidence_required: Duplicate/concurrent/failure-injection and identity-collision tests.

requirements.title: Auditable revert
requirements.acceptance: Every applied field mutation creates traceable change event; approved changes can revert safely without erasing history.
requirements.evidence_required: Apply→serve→revert→serve integration and actor/source audit readback.

requirements.title: Stable read/API contracts
requirements.acceptance: Consumer, TDR Pro and separately authorized Dealership Toolkit share canonical facts through typed entitlement-safe read models.
requirements.evidence_required: Negative tenant/scope tests, stable contract fixtures, snapshot consistency.

requirements.title: Parallel engine safety
requirements.acceptance: Price Fetcher, Spec Filler, Ice file reader, CN–TH crosswalk and Thai competitor graph do not share unauthorized write/identity mechanisms.
requirements.evidence_required: Source/fact authority table and forbidden-crosswalk/write integration tests.
